novels.title: The Tea Shop at World's Edge
novels.author: Hana Miyazaki
novels.synopsis: After retiring early from the Royal Vanguard with a tired sword arm and a tiny pension, Mira opens a wooden teahouse on the quiet mist-shrouded cliff where the mortal kingdom meets the Fae Wilds. Dragons, cursed knights, and lost spirits all have one rule inside her door: leave your weapons on the porch and finish your scones.
novels.latestChapterTitle: Chapter 1: No Swords Past the Welcome Mat

novels.title: Jade Sovereign of the Shattered Heavens
novels.author: Lin Chen
novels.synopsis: Cast down from the Ninth Immortal Spire during a tribulation betrayed by his own sworn brothers, Grand Alchemist Shen Wuying wakes three centuries later inside the crippled meridians of a disgraced frontier clerk. Armed only with a cracked Jade Cauldron and memories of forgotten heavenly pill formulas, he must forge a new Dao across the fractured mortal realms before the heavens seal forever.

novels.title: Architect of the Infinite Dungeon
novels.author: Marcus Vance
novels.synopsis: When Earth's orbital ring collapses into the System Integration event, structural engineer Kai Mercer doesn't receive a combat class—he receives [Grand Architect — Unique]. Instead of swinging a sword, he designs physics-defying labyrinth floors, automated mana turbines, and impenetrable strongholds that turn humanity's last safe zone into an unstoppable fortress.

novels.title: Velvet Dagger, Crown of Ash
novels.author: Evelyn Croft
novels.synopsis: Forced into a diplomatic betrothal with the frost-eyed Archduke who dismantled her family's southern fleet, Lady Seraphina arrives at the Winter Palace with a trunk full of silk gowns, three hidden poison rings, and a plan to ruin him—only to discover someone inside his own court is trying to assassinate them both.

novels.title: Neon Requiem 2099
novels.author: Kaito Sato
novels.synopsis: Memory-broker Ren Takahashi deals in stolen dreams beneath the perpetual acid rain of Neo-Osaka. When a corporate courier drops dead in his noodle stall carrying an unencrypted sentient AI core—one that insists it remembers Ren's own deleted past—every syndicate in the orbital stack puts a bounty on his head.

novels.title: Ember-Born Academy
novels.author: Sora Lindqvist
novels.synopsis: At Solis Citadel, every mage is judged by the color of their spark. Orphaned blacksmith apprentice Rowan lights the Awakening Brazier with a cold blue ash-flame that hasn't been seen since the fall of the First Dragon Riders—earning him a reluctant scholarship and a target on his back.

novels.title: The Thirteenth Witness
novels.author: Arthur Pendelton
novels.synopsis: Twelve jurors locked inside a snowbound Alpine manor to re-examine a ten-year-old cold case wake up on the second morning to find the courtroom stenographer missing—and a thirteenth place setting neatly laid at the breakfast table.

novels.title: Chronicles of the Clockwork Archive
novels.author: Clara Thorne
novels.synopsis: In the brass-domed metropolis of New Aethelgard, junior archivist Beatrice Quill discovers a forbidden brass cylinder containing the recorded final breath of the city's vanished founder—and a blueprint proving the Great Sky-Engine is counting down to zero.
